limitations: Local PostgreSQL quotas are not RDS I/O proof.
Generator, API and worker use separate Node processes with512MiB heap caps; Windows process CPU and RSS are not hard-limited.
Managed-browser enforcement is not simulated-client ACK evidence.
Cold PostgreSQL shared buffers; host filesystem caches are not flushed. Real login/capability/report preflights happen before the measured traffic.
The scheduler fleet and all other hourly jobs are outside this bounded two-school operation test.
